lessons.artifact: The niche triangle applied to your own three candidate niches, in writing.
needs: Nothing. This is the first lesson in the manual.
steps: Read the chapter end to end.
Write down your three candidate niches before you move on.
lessons.title: Read Phase 0: Start From Nothing

lessons.artifact: Your niche statement, written, with every blank filled.
needs: The Niche Picker (Tool 01), if a blank will not fill
steps: Run the Niche Picker if you cannot name your format yet.
Fill every blank: I make [format] about [topic] for [specific person] who wants [transformation].
Read the sentence aloud. If it could describe any channel, rewrite it.
lessons.title: Write your niche statement

lessons.artifact: Three niches priced at the same view count, the per-view gap in writing.
steps: Price your first candidate niche at a view count you can defend.
Price the second and third niches at the same view count.
Write the per-view gap between the three where you can see it.
lessons.title: Run the money check on three niches

lessons.artifact: A format decision you can sustain for 100 videos, recorded in the Format Fit Finder.
steps: Run the Format Fit Finder against your niche statement.
Answer honestly whether you could make 100 of the format it returns.
If the answer is no, rerun it with the constraint that beat you.
lessons.title: Pick the format you can sustain

lessons.artifact: A written 90-day target in the Planner: uploads, one growth bet, one money bet.
steps: Enter your upload count for the next 90 days.
Name one growth bet: the thing most likely to grow the channel.
Name one money bet: the thing most likely to pay first.
lessons.title: Set the 90-day target

lessons.artifact: One idea carried through the engine on paper: pillar, template, batch, calendar slot.
steps: Read the chapter end to end.
Name your pillars: the two or three subjects every upload will come from.
lessons.title: Read Phase 1: The Content Engine

lessons.artifact: Twenty scored ideas in the Idea Bank.
steps: List ideas until you reach twenty. Do not judge them on the way in.
Score each one against your niche statement.
Cut anything that scores on neither demand nor edge.
lessons.title: Bank twenty ideas

lessons.artifact: Five written hooks, one on each of five banked ideas.
steps: Take your five strongest banked ideas.
Write a first-three-seconds hook for each one in the Hook Builder.
Read each hook aloud. Rewrite any you stumble over.
lessons.title: Write five hooks before filming anything

lessons.artifact: One shoot day planned: a week's output as a single shot list.
steps: Pick the week's five hooked ideas.
Turn them into one shoot day in the Batching Planner.
Write the shot list in filming order, not publishing order.
lessons.title: Plan one batch day

lessons.artifact: Ninety days of publishing slots on the calendar, gaps visible.
steps: Lay your Stage 1 target over the next ninety days.
Place batch days first, then the publishing slots they feed.
Leave the empty slots visible. They are the plan's honest part.
lessons.title: Put ninety days on the calendar

lessons.artifact: The algorithm's two questions applied to your last three titles and thumbnails, in writing.
steps: Read the chapter end to end.
Score your last three titles and thumbnails against the two questions: does the click happen, does the viewer stay.
lessons.title: Read Phase 2: YouTube Mastery

lessons.artifact: One pillar mapped to five platforms, each adaptation named.
steps: Read the chapter end to end.
Pick the one pillar you will take everywhere first.
lessons.title: Read Phase 3: The Everywhere Engine

lessons.artifact: A weekly cadence set in the Cadence Coach and kept two consecutive weeks.
steps: Set a weekly rhythm in the Cadence Coach that your batch day can feed.
Publish to it for two consecutive weeks.
If a week breaks, shrink the rhythm instead of skipping the drill.
lessons.time: 20 min to set, two weeks to prove
lessons.title: Lock your cadence

lessons.artifact: One published pillar adapted, not re-uploaded, to a second platform.
steps: Choose the published pillar with the strongest first week.
Adapt it to a second platform in the Cross-Post Optimizer: new hook, native grammar, no watermark.
Publish the adaptation and log both versions.
lessons.title: Take one pillar everywhere

lessons.artifact: A diagnosis of your weakest video, with the fix written into the next video's plan.
steps: Pick your weakest performer, not your favourite.
Run it through Diagnose My Video to the exact failure point.
Write the fix into the next video's plan before you film anything.
lessons.title: Diagnose your weakest video

lessons.artifact: Your channel measured against the thresholds that will apply to you, with the date attached.
needs: A YouTube channel, at any size
steps: Enter your channel's real numbers.
Read the thresholds that will actually apply to you, with the date attached.
Note the gap between where you stand and the gate.
lessons.title: Check the monetization gate

lessons.artifact: One community ritual chosen and scheduled: the unsexy work, on the calendar.
steps: Read the chapter end to end.
Choose the one community ritual you will run first.
lessons.title: Read Phase 4: Audience to Community

lessons.artifact: One borrowed format, adapted to your niche on paper, with the research attached.
steps: Read the dossiers for the formats nearest your niche.
Pick one format to borrow. Note what you are changing and why.
lessons.title: Read the Breakout Format Intel

lessons.artifact: Your twelve numbers defined from your own channel's data, no term left as a vibe.
needs: A channel with published videos and analytics
steps: Pull your own channel's data in the API Explorer.
Define each of the twelve numbers from your data, not from memory.
Write down the one number this month's work has to move.
lessons.title: Learn your twelve numbers

lessons.artifact: One real pitch, written, sent, and logged in the Outreach Center.
steps: Name one creator in your niche whose audience overlaps yours.
Write the pitch in the Outreach Center: specific, short, easy to refuse.
Send it, and log it.
lessons.title: Run one outreach play

lessons.artifact: Your money layers ordered: ads, sponsors, affiliates, products, in the sequence you will build them.
steps: Read the chapter end to end. Then read it again.
Write your money layers in the order you will build them.
lessons.title: Read Phase 5: The Monetization Stack

lessons.artifact: A written call on merch: yes or no, with your margins in the open.
steps: Read the chapter end to end.
Make the merch call for your channel today: yes or no, and why.
lessons.title: Read Phase 6: Merch & Brand

lessons.artifact: Your business paperwork listed, and the channel's money separated from yours on paper.
steps: Read the chapter end to end.
List the paperwork your business is missing. Educational, not advice.
lessons.title: Read Phase 7: The Business

lessons.artifact: One system documented so the channel runs a week without your calendar.
steps: Read the chapter end to end.
Pick the one job only you do that a system could carry for a week.
lessons.title: Read Phase 8: Scale

lessons.artifact: Your rate evidence assembled: what the market pays your niche and size.
steps: Read the file end to end.
Find your niche and size band. Note the range, not the headline.
lessons.title: Read the Rate Card intel file

lessons.artifact: A sponsor shortlist worked like a professional's: found, priced, ready to pitch.
steps: Read the playbook end to end.
Draft your sponsor shortlist as you read: brands that already buy channels like yours.
lessons.title: Read the Sponsor Playbook

lessons.artifact: The standing rules of every platform you earn on, checked off platform by platform.
steps: Read the sections for every platform you earn on.
Check your current practices against each platform's standing rules.
lessons.title: Read the Platform Rules Bible

lessons.artifact: Your rate card, built and ready to send without a rewrite.
steps: Enter your real numbers, not your ambitions.
Price every format you sell from the evidence in Lesson 5.5.
Read the finished card as a brand would. Fix anything you would have to explain.
lessons.title: Build your rate card

lessons.artifact: The first inquiry priced from evidence and answered from the Negotiation Kit.
steps: Take the first brand inquiry, or rehearse with a realistic one.
Price it in the Deal Analyzer from your rate card.
Answer from the Negotiation Kit. No number invented in the reply box.
lessons.title: Price the first real inquiry

lessons.artifact: Every live deal on the Pipeline board at its true stage.
steps: Enter every live deal, including the ones living in your inbox.
Place each at its true stage. No optimism.
Open the Follow-Through Queue and make it your morning list.
lessons.title: Open the pipeline

lessons.artifact: One month of books read against the board: landed, owed, and platform risk, in numbers.
needs: The Sponsor Income Ledger (Tool 20), the Receivables Register (Tool 21), the Brand Ledger (Tool 22), the Platform Ledger (Tool 23)
steps: Read the Sponsor Income Ledger against the Pipeline board.
Read the Receivables Register: what is owed, and since when.
Read the Brand and Platform Ledgers: what landed, and what rides on one platform.
lessons.title: Run the books once

lessons.artifact: The hire decision, either way, written down with its numbers.
steps: Price the hire in the Hiring Cost Calculator: full cost, not the wage.
Price the same hire in the Empire Simulator.
Write the decision down with its numbers, either way.
lessons.title: Model the first hire before making it

note: The lesson spec table for the Zero-to-Career Path (Creator identity pass, rotation 22). One record per lesson, keyed to the lesson ids in assets/js/career-path.js: number and name (the manual's name formula), kind, time it takes, difficulty from the closed five-grade vocabulary (Very easy, Easy, Moderate, Difficult, Very difficult), what you need, the numbered steps, the conclusion line naming the artifact produced, and the state word from the closed vocabulary (current, superseded). Consumed by scripts/build.py (home contents, chapter spec blocks) and by assets/js/career-path-ui.js (the trail's lesson anatomy). Parity with career-path.js is pinned by tests/creator-r22.test.js.
